notes: R0020 reuses the R0019 fifteen-aircraft traffic, radio, policy-group, ACC and safety inputs.
Each aircraft retains its corridor-entry flow as an immutable nominal flow.
A policy-avoidance movement uses the frozen Step-2 strict condition J_move < J_stay and frozen within-aircraft selector ordering.
When off nominal, one safe step toward the nominal flow is prioritized if it completes within the 120 s common horizon and is no worse in integrated or endpoint policy.
All movements use the existing quintic trajectory and motion/curvature limits.
The existing conservative one-start-per-decision-clock arbitration is retained as a provisional multi-aircraft execution mechanism, not a confirmed optimal rule.
Capacity, utilization, radio load and throughput are deliberately not estimated.
